features.definition: Dominant body color is blue (0=not blue at all, 1=entirely blue)
Dominant body color is green (0=not green at all, 1=entirely green)
Dominant body color is brown or tan (0=not brown/tan, 1=entirely brown/tan)
Dominant body color is red or orange (0=none, 1=entirely red/orange)
1 if the Pokémon has visible wings or wing-like appendages, 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon stands/moves on two legs (biped), 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon has four legs and moves on all fours (or mostly so), 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon has a long snake-like or eel-like body without prominent limbs, 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon has a blob, slime, or ghost-like amorphous body, 0 otherwise
Degree to which the Pokémon incorporates plant elements (leaves, vines, flowers, wood) (0=none, 1=entirely plant-based)
1 if the Pokémon has metallic, mechanical, or robotic features, 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon resembles an insect or arthropod (multiple legs, exoskeleton, antennae, wings as insect), 0 otherwise
Degree to which the Pokémon appears water/aquatic themed (fins, bubbles, wet texture, flipper-like limbs) (0=none, 1=strongly aquatic)
1 if the Pokémon resembles a dragon or dinosaur (scales, horns, tail, reptilian body), 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon resembles a bird (beak, feathers, talons), 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon resembles a mammal (fur, ears, paws), 0 otherwise
Perceived body size relative to typical Pokémon (0=very small/tiny, 1=very large/imposing)
Degree to which the Pokémon has a cute, friendly, or happy expression (0=aggressive/scary/sad, 1=very cute/friendly)
1 if the Pokémon has a roughly humanoid body plan (upright, two arms, two legs, recognizable torso), 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon has a visible tail, 0 otherwise
1 if the image shows more than one distinct creature/form together, 0 otherwise
1 if the Pokémon incorporates cloud, smoke, or gas as part of its body, 0 otherwise
Degree to which the Pokémon has spikes, horns, or sharp protrusions on its body (0=none, 1=many prominent spikes)
Degree to which the Pokémon has dark colors (black, dark blue, dark gray) as dominant or significant (0=none, 1=mostly dark)
1 if the Pokémon has notably large, prominent, or glowing eyes as a key feature, 0 otherwise

Degree to which the Pokémon looks like a plain, everyday animal or creature without exotic elemental features (no obvious fire/water/electric/dragon theming) - 0=strongly elemental/exotic, 1=plain natural animal
1 if the Pokémon has visible electric/lightning features (yellow stars, lightning bolt markings, sparks, electric patterns), 0 otherwise
Degree to which the Pokémon's body is predominantly blue or teal in color (0=no blue/teal at all, 1=entirely blue/teal)

notes: The grouping criterion appears to be dominant body color - specifically blue-colored Pokémon vs non-blue Pokémon. item_004, item_034, item_000, item_039, item_058, item_038, item_044, item_056, item_013 are all blue-dominant. item_005 (yellow), item_007 (green/teal), item_036 (brown/red), item_003 (brown/red) are non-blue. Need to heavily boost blue_dominant and reduce all other features that create spurious groupings by body type, plant features, dragon features, etc.
